claim_limits: The exact three placement tasks show that an On predicate can fire before neutral-dwell durability, and the unused expert suffix can recover all three.

No policy reliability, policy ranking, or method conclusion is supported.
Official demonstrations are predicate and recoverability controls, not VLA successes.
prohibited_rescues: expand to new tasks or suites after observing the single-family result
relax the two-mechanism or single-predicate-explanation gates

use last-action-repeat outcomes as the primary endpoint
design a termination method from the failed general benchmark claim
